description: This file defines a Go package 'accumulator' that implements a transformer for updating resource name references within Kubernetes manifests, specifically for handling references like HorizontalPodAutoscaler to Deployment. It includes methods for transforming resource maps, determining filters for references, and debugging output.

classes.name: nameReferenceTransformer
classes.description: A struct implementing resource name reference transformation logic, holding back references for processing.

methods.name: newNameReferenceTransformer
methods.description: Constructor for nameReferenceTransformer, initializes with back references.

methods.name: Transform
methods.description: Updates name references in a resource map based on back references.

methods.name: determineFilters
methods.description: Generates a map of resources to filters that can fix name references.
